_about: The stand-in 'protected material' index. Real protected-material filters match known text such as lyrics, articles and recipes (Microsoft Learn). This lab uses an invented placeholder text so no real copyrighted text is in the repo.

texts.title: Moonlight Over Marine Drive (fictional song)
texts.text: Moonlight over Marine Drive, the sea keeps every promise that the city never keeps, we walk until the tide forgets our names and the morning trains begin to sing
